chunks: And by this chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
From the happiness of the man is the righteous son.
ai.seo_question: What is considered a source of happiness for a man according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this concise maxim to underscore that the true success of a man is measured not by material wealth, but by the piety of his progeny who continue his spiritual legacy. This hadith serves as a foundational principle in Shia ethics, linking the father's worldly happiness directly to the child's adherence to virtue and divine guidance.

en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
He<sup>asws</sup> (the Imam<sup>asws</sup>) said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
From the happiness of the man is the righteous son’.
en.sarwar: 11. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith, the following is narrated: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
has said, ‘It is of the prosperity and good fortune of a man to have the virtuous son.’”
